content_sections.heading: About AIC STPI Bengaluru
content_sections.text: AIC STPI Bengaluru is an incubation centre in Bengaluru, Karnataka. It works under STPI and STPINEXT Initiatives, whose logos appear on the notice. It runs incubation programmes and Open Challenge Programs (OCPs) for startups, gives marketing assistance to the startups it incubates, and manages AIM/STPI grants.

content_sections.heading: AIC STPI Bengaluru Administrative Executive and Marketing & Project Coordinator Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Age limit: below 35 years for both posts. Age is counted as on the last date for receiving applications. The notice says relaxation is permissible for deserving candidates. Experience in the relevant field counts only from the date you obtained the minimum essential qualification. The Administrative Executive role needs strong financial expertise, Tally/ERP accounting, and good Excel, data management and MIS reporting skills. The Marketing & Project Coordinator role needs business development, startup ecosystem engagement, digital marketing, social media management and AI-enabled communication skills. Read the official notification for the full eligibility of each post.

rows.qualification_and_experience: B.Com / M.Com / MBA (Finance) or equivalent; 2-3 years of experience
MBA – Marketing / Business Development / Communications or equivalent; 2-3 years of experience

content_sections.heading: Duties of Each Post
content_sections.text: This post handles the centre's administration, finance and grant management from start to finish. Finance and accounts: vouchers, ledgers, bank reconciliation, vendor payments, bills, invoices and reimbursements; Income & Expenditure and Receipts & Payments statements; MIS reports; budget-head-wise expenditure tracking. Grant and government finance: AIM/STPI grant use and balance tracking; Utilization Certificates (UCs); PFMS-related processes and grant releases; financial reporting for AIM, STPI, PMG, the Governing Board and audits. Statutory compliance: GST, TDS, PF and ESI; coordination with the Chartered Accountant, the auditor and statutory consultants; keeping audit records up to date. Administration and procurement: day-to-day administration of the Incubation Centre; vendor records, quotations, work orders and contracts; procurement under government/STPI procedures; asset and inventory records. e-Office: e-Office/Parichay file creation, movement and tracking; notes for internal approvals; following up on pending approvals. This post supports the centre's startup outreach, partnerships, marketing, digital presence and programmes. Startup outreach and OCP: outreach for Open Challenge Programs and incubation programmes; startup databases; coordination with universities, incubators, accelerators and startup communities; application campaigns and screening. Business development: partnerships with corporates, GCCs, industry, academia, investors, hospitals, technology companies and CSR organisations; proposals and MoUs; CSR support, sponsorships and investor roundtables. Marketing and digital presence: LinkedIn and other social media channels, website content and newsletters; startup and founder stories; press releases; content calendars and engagement analytics; working with photography, video and agency vendors. Digital marketing: tools such as Canva for communication material, and analytics tools to measure campaigns. Programmes and events: OCPs, workshops, Demo Days, hackathons and investor engagements; an annual/quarterly events calendar; post-event reporting. Startup marketing assistance: putting marketing assistance in place for incubated startups and tracking its use and results.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: A Screening Committee checks the applications received by the last date. It looks at qualifications, age, academic record and relevant experience. Candidates who meet the advertised qualifications and experience may be screened in. Screened-in candidates are called for a personal interview before a Selection Committee on the scheduled date and time. The Selection Committee recommends a candidate or a panel of candidates, in order of merit, for appointment. Applying does not by itself mean you will be called for a test or interview.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The contract runs for 3 years or until the end of AIC STPI Bengaluru, whichever is earlier. It may be renewed based on performance, subject to the project tenure being extended. Both posts report to the CEO or the STPI Jurisdictional Director, as the STPI Jurisdictional Director decides. The job is based in Bengaluru, Karnataka. The work location can change by mutual agreement. If a candidate is found ineligible on any ground after appointment, their services may be terminated without a reason being given. Any litigation is subject to the jurisdiction of Delhi courts.

faq.question: Q1. How many posts does AIC STPI Bengaluru have?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 Administrative Executive and 1 Marketing & Project Coordinator. The notice does not print a number, so each post is counted as 1.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary for these posts?
faq.answer: Both posts pay Rs. 50,000 per month.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification do I need for the Administrative Executive post?
faq.answer: You need a B.Com, M.Com or MBA (Finance), or an equivalent qualification, and 2-3 years of experience.

faq.question: Q4. Which MBA specialisations are accepted for Marketing & Project Coordinator?
faq.answer: The notice accepts an MBA in Marketing, Business Development or Communications, or an equivalent qualification.

faq.question: Q5. On which date is age counted?
faq.answer: Your age is counted as on the last date for receiving applications. You must be below 35 years, and relaxation is permissible for deserving candidates.

faq.question: Q6. Does experience before my degree count?
faq.answer: No. Experience in the relevant field counts only after you have obtained the minimum essential qualification.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. It is a contract for 3 years or co-terminus with AIC STPI Bengaluru, whichever is earlier. It may be renewed based on performance, subject to the project tenure being extended.

faq.question: Q8. Will there be an interview?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates screened in by the Screening Committee will have a personal interview before a Selection Committee. The committee then recommends candidates in order of merit.

faq.question: Q9. Which software skills are useful for these roles?
faq.answer: The Administrative Executive works with Tally/ERP, Excel, PFMS and e-Office/Parichay. The Marketing & Project Coordinator uses Canva and other content tools, analytics tools, and LinkedIn and other social media channels.
